name: evalkit
description: Evaluate and compare skills and models with static reviews and worktree-isolated coding-task harnesses.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate and compare skills and models
interface.longDescription: Review skill authoring quality statically, or measure real coding-task outcomes by running the same task under isolated git worktrees while varying one factor: a skill's presence, one skill versus another, or one model versus another. Includes a worktree cleanup skill for the harness leftovers.
defaultPrompt: Review the authoring quality of this skill.
